name: doodlerush
description: DoodleRush multiplayer drawing and guessing game monorepo

scripts.predev: npm run build --workspace=@doodlerush/shared && npm run build --workspace=@doodlerush/game-engine
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names web,server --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@doodlerush/web" "npm run dev --workspace=@doodlerush/server"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace=@doodlerush/shared && npm run build --workspace=@doodlerush/game-engine && npm run dev --workspace=@doodlerush/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace=@doodlerush/shared && npm run build --workspace=@doodlerush/game-engine && npm run dev --workspace=@doodlerush/server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@doodlerush/shared && npm run build --workspace=@doodlerush/game-engine && npm run build --workspace=@doodlerush/web && npm run build --workspace=@doodlerush/server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@doodlerush/game-engine && npm run build --workspace=@doodlerush/shared && npm run build --workspace=@doodlerush/game-engine && npm run test --workspace=@doodlerush/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@doodlerush/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@doodlerush/game-engine && npm run typecheck --workspace=@doodlerush/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@doodlerush/web
